title: DELTA PCBM: Leakage-Controlled Active Learning for Longitudinal HD-sEMG
description: Reference implementation, audit artifacts, and preserved analysis provenance for predicted-class-balanced active learning under a leakage-controlled longitudinal HD-sEMG adaptation protocol using the DELTA dataset.
